latestTerminalSummary:
Three findings. Static review only; no project execution, writes, network, or nested agents.

1. **[P1] Supervisor interruption leaves worker running.** [train_teacher.py:561](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/.cache/v2-m3-runtime-review-r1/python/dodge_rl/train_teacher.py:561) catches `Exception`; `KeyboardInterrupt` bypasses cleanup. Worker starts with `start_new_session=True`, so Ctrl-C sent to supervisor does not reach it. `finally` writes receipts but never calls `stop_owned`. Trigger: interrupt supervisor while worker runs. Consequence: training continues without external supervision or an orderly failure checkpoint. Owned-process cleanup must also run on cancellation.

2. **[P1] Resume makes interrupted weights eligible immediately.** [train_teacher.py:140](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/.cache/v2-m3-runtime-review-r1/python/dodge_rl/train_teacher.py:140) initializes `self.progress = {}`. Resume restores partially updated weights and counts interrupted optimizer steps, but never restores the incomplete-update marker. Trigger: interrupt first stage update after an optimizer step, then authorize same-phase resume. Restored `phase_updates == 0` causes immediate candidate evaluation at line 322. Checkpoint now has tag `candidate` and empty progress; a passing certificate permits advancement without another completed update. Existing tests reject the original interrupted checkpoint, not this resumed path.

3. **[P1] Latest periodic checkpoint can restart an expired phase.** [train_teacher.py:84](/Users/taylor/.t3/worktrees/dodge-native/t3-c8044e79/learning/.cache/v2-m3-runtime-review-r1/python/dodge_rl/train_teacher.py:84) deducts only wall time stored in selected checkpoint. Supervisor records later consumption at line 573, but resume never consults it. Trigger: periodic checkpoint records 1,600 seconds; worker hangs and receives forced termination after the 1,800-second deadline, leaving no newer checkpoint. Resuming that latest valid checkpoint grants another 200 seconds. Same identity and lease checks pass. Resume needs an anchored consumption record covering time after checkpoint creation.

Verified supplied manifest, identity, raw/semantic config, contract, protocol, and qualification hashes. All **818 capsule files**, **71 source pins**, and **50 native-input pins** match. Exact seed: `5562878279179977985`. Final capsule rehash unchanged.
